content:
It's Saturday evening. Mr Quan and his wife, Lan, are sitting on the sofa. They want to choose a film that the whole family can enjoy.

Quan says, "How about this one? It's a comedy that has very good reviews."
"What is it about?"
"A dog that can talk. It helps a family who loses all their money."
Lan laughs. "That might be good for the children. But your mother is coming too. She might not like a film about a talking dog."
"OK. What about this one? It's about an old man who opens a noodle shop in Hanoi."
"Who is the actor?"
"Hoai Linh. He's the actor who made everyone laugh in that Tet film last year."
"Oh, I love him. That must be funny."
"But look at the reviews. Only two stars."
"Two stars? Then it can't be very good. People who watched it must be disappointed."
Quan scrolls down. "Here's another one. It has four and a half stars. It's about a family whose car breaks down on the way to Da Lat."
"That sounds like us last summer!"
"Exactly. The children might laugh a lot, and my mother loves Da Lat."
Lan says, "Perfect. Let's watch that one. I'll call the children."

grammarNote.title: Mệnh đề quan hệ (who, which, that, whose, where)
grammarNote.bodyVi: Mệnh đề quan hệ giúp mô tả bộ phim, nhân vật, diễn viên: a film that the whole family can enjoy, a comedy that has very good reviews, a family who loses all their money, the actor who made everyone laugh, a family whose car breaks down. People who watched it = những người đã xem phim. Bài còn dùng might / must / can't để đoán phim hay hay dở.
examples: They want to choose a film that the whole family can enjoy.
It's a comedy that has very good reviews."
It's about a family whose car breaks down on the way to Da Lat."

practice.objectiveVi: Bạn có thể chọn và giới thiệu một bộ phim bằng mệnh đề quan hệ (a film that…, an actor who…, a family whose…) và đoán bằng might / must / can't.

People who watched it must be disappointed."

grammarStep.questionVi: Trong "People who watched it must be disappointed", mệnh đề quan hệ đứng ở đâu?
options: Ngay sau danh từ people, trước động từ chính must be.
grammarStep.explanationVi: Mệnh đề quan hệ luôn đứng ngay sau danh từ nó bổ nghĩa, kể cả khi danh từ đó là chủ ngữ: People [who watched it] must be disappointed.
grammarStep.whenVi: Dùng mệnh đề quan hệ để mô tả bộ phim, nhân vật, diễn viên khi chọn phim.

grammarStep.noteVi: Động từ trong mệnh đề quan hệ chia theo danh từ đứng trước: a family who loses (số ít), people who watch (số nhiều).

writingHelp.grammarLabelVi: Có ít nhất 1 mệnh đề quan hệ (who, which, that, whose, where)
outlineVi: Bộ phim đó là phim gì, nói về ai (a film about a … who …).
Diễn viên chính (the actor who plays …).
Vì sao cả nhà thích (It's a film that …).
writingHelp.modelAnswer: Last Tet, my family watched a comedy about a man who wants to win a cooking competition. The actor who plays the man is very funny, and his wife is a woman whose food is terrible. It's a film that everyone in my family can enjoy, from my little brother to my grandmother. We laughed so much that my father cried.
